svg.aria-label: Projects: NurtureMe AI recruiting platform with the Stella voice agent; custom LLM models; Jaguar Land Rover South Africa dealer management system; high-traffic APIs and microservices.
svg.text: Built “Stella”, an AI voice agent that phones candidates over Twilio + OpenAI Realtime, with

products with RAG and function calling.
